title: On Krull's Dimension Theorem for Certain Graded Rings and Its Applications
summary: This paper explores the dimension theory of non-Noetherian graded rings by introducing the class of Hilbert--Serre rings. Motivated by Krull's dimension theorem and Smoke's dimension theorem, we establish the fundamental inequalities $\operatorname{dim_{gr}}(R) \leq \dim(R) \leq \operatorname{GKdim}_k(R) \leq d(R)$ for any Hilbert--Serre ring $R$, where $d(R)$ is the pole order of its Poincaré series at $t=1$.
